English: Stone Marker
A simple standing stone marks the sacred ground, designating the area for ritual gatherings and clan meetings.
Wicker Fence
A circle of woven wickerwork fences encircles the ritual area, providing a sense of enclosure and sanctity.
Shrine Patch
A patch of earth is cleared and adorned with offerings, animal bones, and totems, serving as a basic shrine for rituals.
Ancestor Pavilion
A sturdy wooden pavilion stands for veneration of ancestors, decorated with clan relics and sacred symbols.
Spirit Stand
A raised wooden platform for offerings and shamanic rites, surrounded by carved poles and banners.
Priests Shelter
A simple but sturdy structure built for the clans priest or shaman, sheltering them and housing ceremonial tools.
Sanctified Ring
An elaborately marked sacred circle, with decorated stones and posts, signifying a space blessed for rituals and clan gatherings.
Diviners Room
A private sanctum for the clan diviner, featuring ritual implements and scrolls, where omens are interpreted for the clans future.
Ritual Chamber
A large, semi-permanent roundhouse with a hearth, used for important ceremonies, feasts, and tribal councils.
Pagan Ritual Ring
An awe-inspiring stone ring with engraved altars, sacred fires, and banners, acting as the heart of tribal worship and unity.
